description: E-commerce platform empowering merchants to build online stores, manage products, orders, and customer data via robust APIs.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth2 for public apps and app-level credentials, token-based headers (X-Auth-Token) for store-level API accounts, and JWTs for storefront/customer authentication.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free trial/sandbox store and generate store-level or app-level API credentials directly in the control panel or Developer Portal for free.
api_notes: Comprehensive coverage of catalog, products, categories, orders, customers, carts, checkouts, and store administration via REST and GraphQL endpoints.
mcp_notes: BigCommerce publishes official MCP servers including the Docs MCP Server, Store Management MCP, Storefront MCP, and WebMCP.
rationale: BigCommerce provides broad REST and GraphQL APIs, self-serve free sandbox credentials, and official MCP server support for building agent toolkits immediately.

evidence.note: Details OAuth-based API accounts, store-level tokens, headers like X-Auth-Token, and JWT authentication methods.
Explains signing up for a free sandbox store and generating API credentials via Settings > API Accounts or the Developer Portal.
Outlines REST and GraphQL API collections covering products, orders, customers, carts, checkouts, and admin operations.
Lists official MCP servers under the API Reference navigation, including Store Management MCP, Storefront MCP, and WebMCP.
